design_description: A bold, Viking-inspired football jersey for Green Heads FC, combining an electric lime-green base with striking black graphics. The design celebrates Norse mythology and Scandinavian heritage through intricate Nordic knotwork across the shoulders, matching Celtic-style sleeve trims, and subtle distressed detailing throughout the fabric. The front features a large, centrally positioned Green Heads FC emblem depicting a fierce green eagle wearing a Viking helmet, surrounded by runic symbols. Below, an elaborate black illustration of a Viking longship sailing across a fjord, framed by pine forests and rugged mountains, creates a dramatic landscape along the lower torso. Black sleeves contrast sharply with the lime-green body, featuring minimalist runic symbols and decorative knotwork at the cuffs. A solid black crew-neck collar completes the look. The back continues the Nordic theme with symmetrical geometric ornaments across the shoulders, bold black player lettering and an oversized number 10. A larger Viking longship illustration dominates the lower section, extending across the hem to create continuity with the front. The result is a high-impact, two-tone design that blends Viking symbolism, detailed storytelling and modern football aesthetics, with strong visual contrast and a distinctive identity.
